verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents an official MCP integration page that connects Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code and any other MCP-compatible client. Through it, agents can query logs, author prompts and scorers, configure monitoring and Topics, and run evals, and a probe confirms the official MCP server page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server in use, and evidence of setup/auth details and the full tool list.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other MCP clients to Braintrust. Query logs, author scorers, configure Topics, and run evals from your editor.
